entities.name: Indian Calico Trade
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Indian cotton calicoes flooded European markets — brighter, softer, and cheaper than European wool or linen. Calico prints became so popular that France and England banned them (Calico Acts) to protect domestic wool industries.
